svg.desc: Cosmos Village LOCATION 6th of October City, Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Education, Egypt COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2018 355 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Cosmos Village ("Mini Egypt") is an educational cultural project in 6th of October City, developed by the Ministry of Education. Spanning 810,000 square meters, it showcases real-scale models of Egypt's landmarks and welcomes up to 2,000 visitors daily. Full project management and supervision, with a construction value of 355 million EGP. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision, project management and project planning.
